name: GHGSat reviewed-null exact-asset, windowed-raster, and local-observability audit
research_question: Do at least 28 distinct MARS-disjoint GHGSat reviewed-null observations have exact public target/reference assets and locally observable 2 km crops suitable for scene-presence negative supervision?

decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.label_boundary: Each source label is a reviewed site-level GHGSat non-detection above applicable sensitivity. Passing this audit authorizes scene-head negative supervision only. It never creates physical-zero truth or an all-zero dense target.
decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.outcome_blindness: No asset URL, item-detail response, raster byte, local observability result, model prediction, MARS development outcome, protected fold outcome, or official benchmark outcome for this source was inspected before freeze.

sentinel_2_l1c_resolution.catalog: Element 84 Earth Search public Sentinel-2 L1C mirror
crosswalk_rules: same sensing timestamp within one second
full geometry contains or touches the frozen source point
deterministic lexicographic Earth Search item ID if an exact physical acquisition has multiple mirror records
sentinel_2_l1c_resolution.processing_edition_policy: The CDSE and public AWS mirror may expose different reprocessing baseline/generation suffixes for the same physical Level-1C acquisition. Record both product URIs; this is allowed only when spacecraft, sensing timestamp, MGRS tile, and L1C level match exactly.
tileinfo_validation: productName equals the Earth Search s2:product_uri without .SAFE
utmZone + latitudeBand + gridSquare equals the frozen MGRS tile
tileInfo sensing time identifies the same physical acquisition

crop_contract.center: exact frozen GHGSat representative longitude/latitude joined by source identity
crop_contract.grid: target acquisition B02 native 10 m grid for Sentinel-2; deterministic 10 m north-up grid centered on the source point in the target Landsat UTM CRS
crop_contract.sentinel_radiometry: raw uint16 Level-1C DN; CloudSEN input DN/10000; four 10 m bands use native/nearest alignment and B11/B12 use the repository MARS-compatible 20 m nearest-down/bilinear-up contract
crop_contract.landsat_radiometry: raw uint16 Collection 2 Level-1 DN with exact item identity retained; bilinear spectral alignment and nearest QA_PIXEL alignment
crop_contract.access: GDAL/rasterio range and window reads only with directory listing disabled; never save a full remote product

local_observability.radiometric_valid_pixel: all six target bands and all six reference bands are finite and nonzero after alignment
local_observability.pass_rule: radiometric valid fraction >= 0.8 and target/reference union clear fraction >= 0.8

supervision_contract.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 constraints from the GHGSat source remain attached to every derived row and any materially trained distributable checkpoint

failure_action: Retire GHGSat as the missing-negative training source without lowering either 0.8 observability threshold, enlarging the crop, substituting L2 products, accepting future/different references, creating zero masks, pooling another failed source, or inspecting model outcomes.
pass_action: Commit only compact receipts and a hash-bound scene-head-only cohort manifest. Then preregister one development-only negative-augmentation experiment with the frozen champion, protected-fold exclusions, site-balanced sampling, and unchanged MARS-S2L evaluation gates before training.
forbidden: full Sentinel-2 or Landsat product downloads
any GHGSat raster or proprietary plume image
any dense no-plume mask derived from the source label
any target/reference choice or crop exclusion based on detector behavior
any protected MARS fold 0/1/2 or official test outcome
any exact-paper score cache or benchmark artifact during acquisition
any location coordinate as a learned model input
claim_boundary: A PASS establishes a geographically novel, locally observable, scene-head-only reviewed-negative acquisition cohort. It does not establish physical-zero methane, dense no-plume truth, model complementarity, calibration, generalization, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
